title: Shared model storage for multi-Spark recipes
summary: CloudlessOS 0.2.7-6 adds managed and custom NFS model storage for DGX Spark clusters, avoiding redundant model-weight copies while preserving safe local runtime caches, strict verification, and automatic recovery.
changes: Add a guided Shared NFS model storage option that turns the coordinator Spark into a private NFSv4.2 model hub without requiring users to enter a server address or export path.
Offer Advanced Interface support for operator-managed NFSv4.1 and NFSv4.2 exports, with bounded inputs and a responsive setup modal across desktop and narrow displays.
Keep CUDA, DeepGEMM, FlashInfer, torch-extension, container-image, and other node-specific runtime caches local while sharing only Hugging Face model weights.
Verify that every enrolled Spark sees the same writable cluster marker before enabling shared storage or launching a recipe, and fail closed instead of silently reverting to unsafe copying.
Serialize shared-cache downloads, promotion, deletion, and garbage collection to prevent concurrent mutation of the same model files.
Make NFS and worker SSH configuration survive service restarts and machine reboots, including retrying worker mounts until the private Spark fabric route is available.
Roll every node back to its previous storage mode when setup fails, preserve hidden local model caches, and cleanly remove generated mount state when returning to local storage.
Refresh stale recipe validation when machine, cluster, or storage facts change so future launches re-check the environment before starting.
